text:
rhea: Quick alert-- noticed a cluster of WS 1006 closes correlated with very small frames (~12-40B) after last night's proxy tweak. Clients reconnect immediately and we get duplicated billing lines.

owen: Is it only WebSockets or SSE too?

rhea: Primarily WS on /v1/stream/respond (eu-west). A couple SSE streams showed truncated events. Packet capture: tiny gzipped chunks split across writes.

sam: Probable cause: http2 write-flush change in proxy causing micro-writes. Options: revert flush or coalesce tiny writes in proxy. Revert has broad perf impact.

lucy: I vote coalesce with guardrails: per-route opt-in, feature flag, and exempt heartbeats (single-byte \n). Heuristic: buffer up to 64 bytes or 40ms, forward early if contents look like valid UTF-8 JSON.

owen: Add metrics first so we can track: stream.small_frame_count and stream.reconnect_rate (labels: route, tenant_id). Also add coalesce_latency_ms.

rhea: Minimal repro: server writes Buffer.from('{"t":"1"}') in a tight loop with 5ms sleeps. Through edge proxy we reproduce, direct to runtime we don't.

sam: Can we ship the proxy change behind a rollout flag and a console "Stream anomalies" tile that shows tiny-frame spikes and reconnect loops?

lucy: I'll add the flag `edge.coalesce_small_frames` with per-route override and CLI toggle for rapid rollback. I'll also ensure telemetry only sends hashes+lengths.

deploy-bot: canary: edge-proxy/staging -> deployed 2026-03-23T12:10:00Z (canary id c-130).

rhea: Staging run with coalesce 64B/40ms: reconnects dropped from ~20/min -> ~3/min for affected clients. p95 token latency +9ms. Holding canary for 90m.

sam: Good. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with manual holds and dashboard checks. Also add a runbook note about how to detect and credit duplicated streams if needed.

lucy: PR opened (WIP). Will attach perf graphs. Will avoid logging raw payloads.

rhea: Thanks. Will post if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
